title: Forecast Streak and Volume
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:forecast
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as forecasts by _time
| eventstats sum(forecasts) as total
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how many predictions you make each month, because a good track record needs a steady volume.
value: Calibration only improves with practice; keeping your forecasting volume up is what makes the skill grow.
implementation: Ingest forecasts into `index=personal`; count per month with a running total.
visualization: Column chart of forecasts made per month.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many predictions you make each month, because getting better needs steady practice.
